rationale: Block 5 covers scales of measurement; this item asks students to classify a variable type — a direct application of that content before the micro-quiz at block 6.

Block 10 covers measures of central tendency and dispersion; block 11 (clinical pearl) addresses the SD vs SE distinction. This TrueFalse item consolidates that key concept before the learner proceeds.
Block 7 covers parametric tests (z-test, t-test, ANOVA); this item asks students to select the correct test for a given scenario — a core applied skill in CM6.3.

Block 10 covers interpretation of p-values, CIs, and statistical vs clinical significance — CM6.5 territory. This TrueFalse item challenges the common misconception that p<0.05 always means a clinically meaningful result.
